prerequisites: Competencies from the basic modules Object-Oriented Programming and Algorithms and Data Structures are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can report on research results from current scientific contributions in national and international journals as well as from conferences in the field of system development.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Content from recent research in the field of system development. The specific technical orientation of the module will be determined by the lecturer.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written examination

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination is an oral examination or a written examination.
bibliography: Will be specified in the module announcement.
